assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
The denied service is CPT 93229 (mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring)
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia recurrence
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation coded as I48.91
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation coded as R00.2
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction coded as Z86.73
The note states that continuous monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG
